quarterly_data.quarter: HPE press release: HPE secures its first AMD Helios order in $1.2 billion deal (09-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: HPE announced a $1.2 billion order from Vultr to deploy AMD Helios AI Rack by HPE systems at Vultr's cloud data center locations in the United States - HPE's first order for the new AMD Helios system, which features purpose-built HPE Networking scale-up switching and software. Each Helios rack integrates 72 AMD Instinct MI455X GPUs with AMD EPYC 'Venice' CPUs, AMD Pensando Vulcano AI NICs and ROCm software; HPE Networking purpose-built for Helios includes six HPE Juniper Networking QFX5252 scale-up Ethernet switch trays per rack connecting all 72 GPUs, and HPE Services covers end-to-end deployment and liquid cooling. The order builds on nearly three years of collaboration between Vultr and Juniper Networks. CEO Antonio Neri: 'AI is driving the largest infrastructure buildout in history'; Helios by HPE 'demonstrates HPE's unique ability to engineer the complete AI architecture with rack-scale compute, scale-up networking, and direct liquid cooling'.
quarterly_data.figure: $1.2 billion order (HPE's first AMD Helios order); 72 MI455X GPUs and six QFX5252 scale-up switch trays per rack
